cards.text: Babylon just heard the LORD announce her downfall (Isaiah 47). Now He turns to His own people: 'Listen to this, O house of Jacob.' These are people from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD and call on the God of Israel.

cards.question: These people swear by the LORD's name and call on the God of Israel. But the LORD says something is missing. What is it?

cards.text: They even call themselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel, the LORD of Hosts. That's like me hanging a BEST BAKERY IN THE DORINVERSE sign out front and never turning on one single oven.
Then the LORD reminds them that He foretold the former things long ago. They came straight out of His own mouth.

cards.question: The LORD foretold the former things long ago. What happened when He acted?

cards.text: Then the LORD paints a picture of His people: 'your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.' Friend, I lay flat in a drawer for YEARS and I was never THAT stiff.

cards.question: Why did the LORD tell His iron-necked people so far ahead? He says, 'For I knew that you are ___.'
The LORD announced things to His stubborn people before they came to pass. What claim does He say that shuts down?

cards.text: They've heard it all, and the LORD asks if they won't acknowledge it. Then He turns the page.

cards.question: After the former things, what does the LORD say He'll tell His people from now on?
The LORD says these new things are created ___, and not long ago.

cards.text: So nobody can claim, 'I already knew them!' No 'yeah, I KNEW that' coworker energy allowed, friend.

cards.question: The LORD says His people's ears have been open for a long time.

cards.text: He knew how deceitful they are, and they've been called a rebel from birth. After THAT, I'm hiding under my chef's hat waiting for the oven door to slam.

cards.question: After calling out His deceitful, stubborn people, what does the LORD say He'll do with His wrath?
The LORD says He restrains His wrath so that His people will not be cut off.

cards.text: He does it for the sake of His name and His praise. Then He says, 'See, I have refined you, but not as silver.'

cards.question: The LORD refined His people, but not as silver. Where does He say He tested them?

answers.text: In the depths of the sea
In the dust of the desert

cards.text: I know ovens, friend, and this furnace is NOT baking cookies. Then the LORD says, 'For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed?'

cards.question: The LORD says He will give His glory to another.

findings.problem: Card 9's setup ('Then He turns the page') and the question's own framing ('After the former things... from now on') rule out both wrong answers. 'Old and familiar things' and 'Past and finished things' are also the same idea, so only one answer is left once the baker reads the setup. Replace the wrong answers with believable new-sounding options, or change the setup line so it doesn't eliminate them.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: The joke 'I'm hiding under my chef's hat waiting for the oven door to slam' doesn't click instantly. An oven door slamming isn't a clear everyday picture of bracing for punishment, so a stranger would likely say 'huh?'.

rule.text: It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining.

findings.problem: This is a 'where' question, but the wrong answer 'In the dust of the desert' doesn't appear to be a real Bible detail. 'In the depths of the sea' is one (for example, Micah 7:19). Swap 'dust of the desert' for a real place or phrase from Scripture.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.

findings.problem: Multiple choice dominates the stop: 6 of the 11 choice cards, against 3 true or false and 2 fill in the blank.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
